title: GgenIgniter Reconciliation Plan
description: The real, pre-actuation plan document a `mix ggen_igniter.sync` (or GgenIgniter.Reactors.ReconcileReactor's :admit-bound plan) run produces BEFORE any byte is written to disk. This is the serialized shape of what admission reasons about: which inputs were loaded and their hashes, which queries ran against which engine and what bindings they discovered, what output each recipe intends to produce (and, for an already-existing target, what decision was made about it), which requested features this run could not honor, and a summed count of the mutations this plan intends to perform. Mirrors GgenIgniter.PendingActuation's real fields (logical_id/target/previous_hash/desired_hash/operation/ownership/semantic_source/compensation_data) at the plan-document level, not the in-process struct level.

schema_version.description: The version of THIS schema the plan document conforms to, e.g. "1.0". Not the ggen_igniter package version.

generated_at.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp this plan was computed.

inputs.description: The real source inputs this plan was computed from, and their content hashes -- so a plan document is independently checkable against the exact ontology/pack bytes that produced it, the same discipline GgenIgniter.Receipt uses for pre_run_hash/post_run_hash.

ontology_path.description: Path to the loaded ontology (.ttl) file, real and resolved, as passed to GgenIgniter.Ontology.load!/1.

ontology_hash.description: sha256:<hex> digest of the ontology file's real on-disk bytes at load time -- same "sha256:" prefix convention as GgenIgniter.Receipt.hash_entries/1.

pack.description: The --pack name this run resolved against, or null when --ontology/--query/--template were passed explicitly (bypassing the priv/ggen/<pack> convention).

pack_dir.description: The real resolved pack directory used, or null when no pack convention applied.

engine.description: Which --engine this plan's queries actually ran against, and why -- so a divergence between engines (a real, documented risk in this repo's ORDER BY history) is traceable from the plan document alone.

name.description: The real engine identity that ran the queries.

selection_reason.description: Why this engine was selected: "default", "--engine flag", or a config-derived reason.

store_id.description: The gnoa:Qlever-typed store id resolved for engine "qlever" (required whenever engine.name == "qlever"); null for in-process engines.

queries.description: One entry per --query run this plan executed (or attempted), in run order.

name.description: The query's logical name, e.g. the left-hand side of --query name=path.rq.

source.description: Where the query text came from: a real file path (path.rq) or the literal string "inline" when supplied directly on the command line.

source_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the query text, when source is a file path; null for inline queries or when hashing was not performed.

bindings_discovered.description: The real SPARQL result variables this query's rows bound, one entry per distinct variable name -- what the render phase actually had available as EEx assigns.

var.description: The SPARQL result variable name (without the leading '?').

row_count.description: How many result rows bound this variable to a non-null value.

outputs.description: One entry per intended output this plan produced -- the plan-document mirror of GgenIgniter.PendingActuation, one row per (template_path, out_template) resolution.

logical_id.description: Stable identity for this one intended output, matching GgenIgniter.PendingActuation.logical_id/3's (recipe_key <> "::" <> target) format for a real target, or "<template_path>=>eval" for operation "eval".

target.description: The real resolved output path, or null only for operation "eval" (nothing is ever written to disk under mode: eval).

template_path.description: The EEx template that produced this output.

out_template.description: The --out-template pattern this target path was resolved from.

operation.description: The derived operation for this output -- never guessed, always derived from real existence + frontmatter/mode, per GgenIgniter.PendingActuation's own documented derivation.

existing_file_decision.description: What this plan decided to do about target's CURRENT on-disk state (if any) -- the plan-document analogue of GgenIgniter.Actuate's real outcome() values.

skip_condition.description: When existing_file_decision is skip_exists or skip_match, the concrete reason this output was skipped (e.g. "target exists and --on-collision skip", "desired content matches on-disk content"); null when no skip occurred.

previous_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of target's real on-disk content before this run, or null if target did not exist (or is null, i.e. eval).

desired_hash.description: sha256:<hex> of the content this run wants at target, or null for operation "delete" (nothing desired there any more).

ownership.description: Whether this recipe's manifest entry already listed target as one of its own outputs BEFORE this run, straight from GgenIgniter.Manifest.output_paths/1.

unsupported_features.description: Requested frontmatter/flag features this plan could NOT honor for this run -- an explicit, honest list rather than a silent no-op, matching this repo's IMPLEMENTED/PARTIAL_ALIVE/PLANNED discipline (docs/status.md).

reason.description: Why this run could not honor it, e.g. "GgenIgniter.Reconcile.run/1 does not yet implement --for-each (see moduledoc)".

recipe_key.description: The specific recipe this unsupported-feature note applies to, or null when it applies to the whole run.

mutations_intended.description: A summed count of the real disk mutations this plan intends to perform, if admitted and actuated -- outputs.length always equals the sum of writes+deletes+injects+evals+skipped.

writes.description: Count of outputs with operation create or replace (existing_file_decision not skip_exists/skip_match).

deletes.description: Count of outputs with operation delete.

injects.description: Count of outputs with operation inject.

evals.description: Count of outputs with operation eval.

skipped.description: Count of outputs whose existing_file_decision is skip_exists or skip_match (no real write occurs).
